paragraphs.source_en: Oichi rode in the foremost palanquin, followed by Princess Chacha and Princess Taka, while last came the nursemaid cradling Princess Tatsu in her arms... Nagamasa escorted them to the main castle gate.

paragraphs.source_zh: 最前面的一乘里坐着阿市，接下来是茶茶姬和高姬，最后是怀抱达姬的乳母……长政将她们送至本城门口。

paragraphs.source_en: Fujikake led the way, while Kimura Koshirō brought up the rear carrying a torch. As they neared the castle gate, Oichi turned to look back at her husband. Nagamasa, gripping a blood-red great sword, stared fixedly at his wife.

units.source_en: “I will go on ahead.”

units.source_en: “Go!”
units.source_zh: “去吧！”

units.source_en: “Yes... yes.”

paragraphs.source_en: The procession set out. The order to cease hostilities had already reached every soldier, and all around them was silent. The Oda soldiers who had come to receive Oichi and her children stood in ranks on either side, leaving a passage for the palanquins.

paragraphs.source_zh: 队伍出发了。休战的命令已经传达给每一个士卒，四周一片寂静。前来迎接阿市母子的织田士兵分列两旁，让过轿子。

paragraphs.source_en: “Chacha...” Oichi called toward the palanquins behind her. “Yes.” Princess Chacha and Princess Taka answered in unison.

units.source_en: “Chacha...” Oichi called toward the palanquins behind her.
units.source_zh: “茶茶……”阿市朝后面的轿子喊道。

units.source_en: “Yes.”
Princess Chacha and Princess Taka answered in unison.
units.source_zh: 茶茶姬和高姬齐声回答。

paragraphs.source_zh: “茶茶……”阿市朝后面的轿子喊道。“在。”茶茶姬和高姬齐声回答。

paragraphs.source_en: “We no longer have to die.” Oichi murmured the words, then gently closed her eyes. At last, no harm need come to those young lives; the warmth of relief spread through her entire body at once. At last, they had begun to leave the cruel battlefield behind, advancing step by step toward fields ablaze with spring flowers. For a moment Oichi could not tell whether she felt sorrow or joy, and tremors passed through her heart.

paragraphs.source_en: The Kyōgoku compound was now close at hand. Fujikake, at the head of the procession, seemed to mutter something, and the company came to a halt. Just then, a short man strode up beside Oichi’s palanquin and called, “Lady Oichi!”

units.source_en: “And you are...?”

paragraphs.source_en: “I am Hashiba Hideyoshi. I have come to see you safely through. The young ladies look well.”

paragraphs.source_en: In the torchlight, a bright smile appeared on Hideyoshi’s face. “Forward!” he ordered.

units.source_en: In the torchlight, a bright smile appeared on Hideyoshi’s face.

paragraphs.source_en: Under Hashiba’s protection, the procession began moving again and soon reached the vicinity of the Sannō compound, where the murmur of a stream could be faintly heard.
